ah: An expression of relief, relaxation, comfort, confusion, understanding, wonder, awe, etc.
aha: An exclamation of understanding, realization, invention, or recognition.
ahead: At or towards the front; in the direction one is facing or moving.
ahem: The sound of a quiet cough or of clearing one's throat.
ahimsa: A doctrine of non-violence, concerned with the sacredness of all living things and an effort to avoid causing harm to them.
ahold: Brought to lie as near to the windward as it can to get out to sea, and thereby held steady.
ahorse: On the back of a horse; on horseback.
ahoy: Used to hail a ship, a boat or a person, or to attract attention.
ahull: at the hull of a ship
